actual.descripcion: A lovesick, penniless transient embarks on a lucrative but perilous career, boiling nitroglycerine off dynamite for a gang of robbers.

siguiente.descripcion: Jet Cosgrave has been swindled out of his father's ranch by a wicked uncle. He returns eight years later with a bunch of gunslingers headed by the psychopathic Duke Rankin, and sets about plotting his revenge. Distractions, in the comely shapes of naïve ranch girl Judy Polsen and Alice Austin, his uncle's fiancée, cannot deter Jet from the final showdown, but not before the two sides have already shed a lot of blood in dirt.

Jamie's having second thoughts about bringing his son Brandon onboard when the teenager spends his pay cheque on ear piercings. Then his right-hand man Kevin shows up to a wreck without the gear he needs to control traffic.

PCs Matt Turner and Ian Cosgrove head to the scene of a collision in Middlewich, where an 11-year-old child has been hit by a van. On the M56, PC Rowan Burt is searching for a driver wanted for unpaid speeding fines.

Chris Spencer and the team chase a Golf GTI that is racing through the streets at three times the legal limit. Reports of gunshots at a house party on a residential street led to a full-scale firearms operation.

Dog handler Steve and the firearms team are in a dramatic doorstep showdown, in which a man is alleged to have attacked someone with an axe and a machete. A stolen van makes off from officers in Leeds before nearly hitting a dog walker. A tactical pursuit and containment collars a disqualified driver who tries to pull the wool over the Interceptors' eyes.
PC Andy Doran is chasing a gang of thieves fleeing a shop robbery in Ellesmere Port. And PC Chris Swash races to the scene of a head-on car collision that has left a driver trapped.

The Interceptors hunt for thieves who stole ten grand's worth of luxury jackets. Police get more than they bargained for when they check out a suspicious car. And a smiling driver gives a masterclass in how not to react to being stopped by the cops.
PC Hayes pursues a man who has been injecting himself in full view of the public. On patrol on the M5, PC Merchant pulls over a man he spots driving while watching TV on his phone.
At the request of a priest, Scully probes the death of a girl with disabilities and uncovers a supernatural mystery.

Walker continues to try to reconnect with his family but finds that his kids have developed new routines with Liam; Captain James tells Walker he needs to get recertified to be a Ranger, but old memories of Emily hinder his progress.
